property_summary: For any two distinct addresses k1,k2 (both different from the owner), an owner call setApprovedLogger(k1,true) followed by setApprovedLogger(k2,false) leaves approvedLoggers(k1)==true; the mutant overwrites msg.sender's slot instead, so k1's approval never appears and approvedLoggers(k1) is false.
change_summary: Write to msg.sender's entry instead of the _logger argument, so keys other than the caller are never updated.
